verdict.rationale: Paxos documents a Sandbox environment for mocking flows, executing transfers and testing integrations. Developers can fund it with test crypto from faucets or the Dashboard Fund button, which supports USD and Paxos-issued stablecoins only. The evidence does not show that payments, payouts (fiat withdrawals) and conversions are explicitly covered in sandbox, nor any deterministic test values. Missing for 10: deterministic magic test values or outcomes, explicit sandbox coverage of payments, payouts and conversions, and independent hands-on corroboration.
